outcome_definition: Outcome = the ABSOLUTE melting temperature Tm (C) of ONE amplicon printed by the paper under ONE HRM run: same EvaGreen master mix, 35 cycles, ramp 60->95 C at 0.1 C/s, Table 6 for the four screening primer pairs and the measured column of Table 9 for psaA-2 and Dia18S. This is NOT a dTm of a genotyping call - the amplicons differ in sequence, so the set constrains a Tm-prediction model (nearest-neighbour dH/dS + salt), not a discrimination rule. mg_mm and dna_ng_ul are NA because the paper prints neither: Mg2+ lives inside a proprietary 2x master mix, so this set cannot fit a salt term. gc_pct/bp/dH/dS are the paper's Table 8; seq_len is nchar of the Table 7 product and seq_len_vs_table_bp is its disagreement with Table 8 bp (never pooled away).
